title: Mortgage QC at 100% Coverage: What Changes When AI Reviews Every Loan Instead of a 10% Sample
summary: GSE quality control rules were written around sampling because full review was impossible by hand. AI removes that constraint. What a full-population pre-funding and post-close QC program looks like, and where the Fannie and Freddie requirements still bind.
body_markdown: GSE quality control rules were written around sampling because full review was impossible by hand. AI removes that constraint. What a full-population pre-funding and post-close QC program looks like, and where the Fannie and Freddie requirements still bind.
